beats.text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Paisley heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
🪤 Paisley is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
Recipe: Snare (Level 1). You have seen a snare. A loop, a stick, an animal.

🪤 Paisley catches you watching the snares come off the line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They show you — the loop, the trigger stick, where the run narrows between the roots. "Opossum trails. Check at dawn. Always." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
👁 It doesn't run — the armor IS the plan. It'll hunch down and dare you. The armor turns a blow; grab the soft underbelly, or trap the grub trail at night.
Ingrid is showing Piper how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
👁 It hears you coming mid-wingbeat — in the air, you don't catch it. Hunt it roosting at dawn, or wait for the water it must come down to.
Brian is showing Agustina how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.

📓 Codex: you've heard of **Beard Moss**. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 80. I've been watching what you're becoming, little living. Names for your shelf: Beard Moss, Cornucopia. What they DO — that's still yours to learn."

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

Agustina leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Extended Warranty. Never stand still. The RING is the telegraph — the pitch itself gives no warning.
